answer: Here is one mechanism that works: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because wharf only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, violet is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any island approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
